title: Set-Aside Desk Guidance: Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve Days on a Further Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the loan's Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, held among the borrower's Set-Aside Accounts, adds days to the extension length:

- Where the reserve is active but holds less than one year's property tax and hazard premium on file, 7 calendar days are added for clearing the coming charges at closing.
- Where that reserve is depleted, 14 calendar days are added to it.
- Otherwise nothing is added.

One year's charges are the annual property tax plus the annual hazard premium on file for the reserve. The reserve's holding is its balance.

| Reserve | Balance compared with a year's tax and hazard premium | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|---|
| active | below | 7 |
| active | equal or above | 0 |
| depleted | any | 14 |
| other status, or none | any | 0 |

## Hypothetical illustration

With yearly charges of 3,000.00 tax and 1,250.00 premium (4,250.00 in all):

- an active reserve holding 4,000.00 adds 7 days;
- a depleted reserve adds 14 days;
- an active reserve holding 4,250.00 adds nothing.
